_comment: Eight files whose frontmatter cannot be read, each producing exactly one ZK002 and nothing else: the point is that a file the parser gave up on is excluded from the checks that read its frontmatter, not treated as an empty one (which would produce a fistful of conformance findings and an isolation finding). The three CRLF notes are the control in the other direction — a Windows-authored note is still a note, so they parse, link and produce nothing.
